items.exampleEn: Despite all our endeavors, the plan failed.
items.exampleZh: 儘管我們盡了一切努力，計畫還是失敗了。

items.exampleEn: The cat licked its paws clean after dinner.
items.exampleZh: 晚餐後，那隻貓把爪子舔乾淨。

items.exampleEn: The sharp metal edge left a long slash in my jacket.
items.exampleZh: 尖銳的金屬邊緣在我的夾克上劃出一道長長的割痕。

items.exampleEn: Philosophers have pondered the meaning of life for centuries.
items.exampleZh: 幾百年來，哲學家一直在思索人生的意義。

items.exampleEn: A murmur of agreement went around the table.
items.exampleZh: 桌邊響起一陣低聲附和。

items.exampleEn: The tall runner strode ahead of the others.
items.exampleZh: 那位高個子跑者大步走在其他人前面。

items.exampleEn: There is green mold on the old bread.
items.exampleZh: 那塊舊麵包上長了綠色的黴。

items.exampleEn: Fans hailed the singer with loud cheers.
items.exampleZh: 歌迷用熱烈的歡呼聲迎接那位歌手。

items.sentenceEn: She stood on the corner and hailed a taxi.
items.sentenceZh: 她站在街角招了一輛計程車。

items.audioEn: We could hear the murmur of the stream from our tent, so we fell asleep easily.
items.audioZh: 我們在帳篷裡聽得到小溪的潺潺聲，所以很快就睡著了。
items.questionZh: 他們在帳篷裡聽到什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The teacher strode across the room to open the window.
items.sentenceZh: 老師大步走過教室去開窗。

items.sentenceEn: I pondered for a moment before I answered her question.
items.sentenceZh: 我想了一會兒才回答她的問題。

items.stemEn: The puppy ran up to me and ____ my face.
items.stemZh: 小狗跑到我面前舔我的臉。

items.stemEn: Write the date with a ____ between the day and the month.
items.stemZh: 寫日期時，在日和月之間加一條斜線。

items.passageEn: Making chocolate by hand is a slow endeavor, my aunt says. Every morning, she melts the chocolate, pours it into small molds and waits for it to cool. While she works, she often ponders new flavors for her secret recipe. Customers walk into her shop with big smiles, and children lick the spoons she gives them. Last month, a food magazine hailed her shop as the best in the city, and now there is a line outside every weekend.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨說，手工做巧克力是一件很費時的事。每天早上，她把巧克力融化，倒進小小的模子裡，再等它冷卻。工作時，她常常為獨門配方構思新口味。顧客們總是笑容滿面地走進店裡，孩子們舔著她給的湯匙。上個月，一本美食雜誌稱讚她的店是全市最棒的，現在每個週末店外都大排長龍。

questions.questionZh: 阿姨把融化的巧克力倒進哪裡？
美食雜誌稱讚後發生了什麼事？
options: 巧克力的價格上漲了不少
每個週末店外大排長龍

items.promptZh: 我聽到隔壁房間傳來一陣低語聲。
referenceEn: I heard a murmur from the next room.
I heard a murmur of voices coming from the room next door.
rubricZh: 要用 murmur（例如 a murmur from…、murmuring 等）
「隔壁房間」可寫，例如 the next room、the room next door 等
時態配合內容（例如 heard、hear 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 lick 造一個句子，說說人或動物舔東西的情景。
referenceEn: My dog always licks my hand when I come home.
I licked the spoon after I made the cake.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 lick（例如 licks my hand、licked the spoon）
時態配合內容（例如 licks、licked 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 36：裁示「評分要點不寫死時態」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："時態用過去式（例如 heard）"；改後："時態配合內容（例如 heard、hear 等）"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：暴風雨造成的是撕裂，不是刀割
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："There was a long slash in the tent after the storm."；改後："The sharp metal edge left a long slash in my jacket."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：暴風雨造成的是撕裂，不是刀割
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："暴風雨過後，帳篷上有一道長長的割痕。"；改後："尖銳的金屬邊緣在我的夾克上劃出一道長長的割痕。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：疑似 24：裁示「聽選正解不可照抄音檔」：正解改寫成同義說法，干擾項沿用音檔裡的字
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["Heavy rain", "The stream nearby", "Loud music next door", "Barking dogs"]；改後：["Rain on the tent", "Running water", "Loud music next door", "Barking dogs"]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：「There was a long slash in the tent after the storm」：slash 是刀刃劃出的割痕，暴風雨造成的應是 tear／rip，情境不合；建議改 Someone had cut a long slash in the tent 或 The knife left a long slash in the seat 之類。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/2 的修正紀錄。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：裁示「評分要點不寫死結構」全批掃描：動詞寫法也正確
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："要用 murmur 當名詞（例如 a murmur from…）"；改後："要用 murmur（例如 a murmur from…、murmuring 等）"
